description: This file contains implementation of functions related to git pack operations such as preparing pack objects, releasing arguments, removing redundant packs, writing pack options, and managing packs within a repository. It includes functions for assessing, marking, and deleting pack files, as well as handling temporary files for packages.

classes.name: struct generated_pack
classes.description: Structure representing a set of temporary files associated with a generated pack, used for managing different file extensions related to pack creation.

methods.name: void prepare_pack_objects(struct child_process * cmd,const struct pack_objects_args * args,const char * out)
methods.description: Configures the arguments for a child process to prepare pack objects based on provided options, adding relevant command line arguments.

methods.name: void pack_objects_args_release(struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with pack objects arguments, freeing dynamically allocated strings.

methods.name: void repack_remove_redundant_pack(struct repository * repo,const char * dir_name,const char * base_name)
methods.description: Removes a redundant pack file from the repository, potentially clearing associated multi-pack index files.

methods.name: const char * write_pack_opts_pack_prefix(const struct write_pack_opts * opts)
methods.description: Determines the pack prefix from the provided pack options, ensuring correctness of path prefixes.

methods.name: bool write_pack_opts_is_local(const struct write_pack_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if the destination path for the pack is local by comparing it to pack directory.

methods.name: int finish_pack_objects_cmd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const struct write_pack_opts * opts,struct child_process * cmd,struct string_list * names)
methods.description: Reads object IDs from the output of the pack-objects command and adds them to a list of names, ensuring they are valid hex IDs.

methods.name: void existing_packs_collect(struct existing_packs * existing,const struct string_list * extra_keep)
methods.description: Collects and categorizes existing packs in the repository, sorting them into kept, non-kept, cruft, and multi-pack index lists.

methods.name: int existing_packs_has_non_kept(const struct existing_packs * existing)
methods.description: Checks if there are any non-kept or cruft packs present.

methods.name: void existing_pack_mark_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Marks a pack for deletion by setting a utility flag on its string list item.

methods.name: void existing_pack_unmark_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Removes the deletion mark from a pack's list item.

methods.name: int existing_pack_is_marked_for_deletion(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Checks if a pack is marked for deletion.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_retained(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Marks a pack as retained to prevent it from being deleted.

methods.name: int existing_pack_is_retained(struct string_list_item * item)
methods.description: Checks if a pack is marked as retained.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_for_deletion_1(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,struct string_list * names,struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Marks packs for deletion based on whether their SHA1 is not in the provided list of names, considering existing retention marks.

methods.name: void existing_packs_retain_cruft(struct existing_packs * existing,struct packed_git * cruft)
methods.description: Marks a specific cruft pack to be retained.

methods.name: void existing_packs_mark_for_deletion(struct existing_packs * existing,struct string_list * names)
methods.description: Marks multiple packs for deletion based on given names.

methods.name: void remove_redundant_packs_1(struct repository * repo,struct string_list * packs,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Deletes pack files that are marked for deletion.

methods.name: void existing_packs_remove_redundant(struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes all packs that have been marked for deletion from the repository.

methods.name: void existing_packs_release(struct existing_packs * existing)
methods.description: Clears all internal lists of existing packs.

methods.name: struct:generated_pack * generated_pack_populate(const char * name,const char * packtmp)
methods.description: Populate a generated pack structure by checking existence of associated files.

methods.name: int generated_pack_has_ext(const struct generated_pack * pack,const char * ext)
methods.description: Checks if a generated pack has a specific extension.

methods.name: void generated_pack_install(struct generated_pack * pack,const char * name,const char * packdir,const char * packtmp)
methods.description: Moves temporary files of generated packs into their final location under the repository's pack directory.
